content: Root cause: The bug was caused by improper resource cleanup in the `ismrmrd_read_header` function, specifically in the handling of the HDF5 dataset and datatype. The original code did not ensure that the dataset and datatype were properly closed before exiting the function, which could lead to memory leaks or resource exhaustion. The patch corrects this by ensuring that the cleanup code is executed in all relevant error paths, thus preventing the introduction of resource management issues.

buggy_stmts_infos.buggy_stmt: -        h5status = H5Dread(dataset, datatype, H5S_ALL, H5S_ALL, H5P_DEFAULT, buff);
-            ISMRMRD_PUSH_ERR(ISMRMRD_FILEERROR, "Failed to close XML header HDF5 datatype.");
-            ISMRMRD_PUSH_ERR(ISMRMRD_FILEERROR, "Failed to close XML header HDF5 dataset.");
